acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the general reports page and sees the report list - features/general-reports/general-reports.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the general reports page
steps.expected: The general reports page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Check the page that is displayed
steps.expected: The general reports page is displayed

steps.action: Check the general reports page content
steps.expected: The report links are visible

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed
